value: Duplicate inventory_levels/update fires for the same restock — the notification_batch keyed by item_external_id + restock_date_bucket deduplicates it; the second delivery exits before selecting any signups or sending any emails.

Inventory briefly spikes then drops again before all emails are dispatched — signups already marked notified in the batch remain notified; the next restock starts a fresh batch for remaining pending signups only.

Partial restock with fewer available units than waitlisted shoppers — only the front-of-queue batch_size signups are notified; the rest stay pending and are picked up on the next restock event, so the batch size config should reflect the merchant's available unit count.

Shopper signs up for the same item from the same email twice — the unique constraint on (email, item_external_id) makes the second insert a no-op; the widget confirms inline without creating a new row.

Notification email delivery fails permanently for a subscriber — the notification_send is marked failed; the signup is NOT re-queued for the same batch cycle but retains notified status so it is excluded from the next batch for that same restock.

Product title or variant name changes in Shopify between restock events — demand_stats_snapshot titles are known-stale until the next batch completion or conversion triggers a snapshot refresh; this is the accepted staleness window and is bounded by the next event.

Restock webhook fires during the configured quiet hours window — select-and-open-notification-batch creates the batch record and notification_send rows but does not dispatch emails; the 15-minute schedule trigger detects the pending sends and dispatches them once the quiet window has passed.

Snapshot refresh triggered for a product-level item (item_type = product) — the productVariant query is skipped; instead the product query fetches the product title and variant_title is stored as null in the snapshot row.
